facts: Parties: Lowther Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Elstree Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Northgate Holdings Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 27 October 2026; Closing is scheduled for 12 December 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 27 October 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 8 February 2027.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,650,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $164,300,000.
